candidates.name: Barbell Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
2
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
3
Stand to your full height and hold.
4
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

candidates.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Sumo Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
2
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and push your heels into the floor.
3
Try to extend your knees and hips simultaneously.

candidates.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Low Bar Squat
Intermediate
1
Pull your shoulder blades back really hard and place the bar on your posterior delts.
2
Push your hips back and break at the knees to initiate the squat.
3
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the ground. Push your heels into the floor and squat back up to a standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell Staggered Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Staggered Deadlift
Advanced
1
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
2
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
Advanced
1
Place the bar between your traps and rear delts. Pull your shoulder blades back to give the bar a shelf to sit on.
2
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. This means you're nearing the end of your Range of Motion with out rounding your spine.
3
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you'e in a standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
Advanced
1
Start by pushing your hips straight back and extending your non-working leg behind you. It is ok to touch your other foot back to the ground each rep.
2
Leave your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstring. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell High Bar Good Morning
candidates.cardText:
Barbell High Bar Good Morning
Advanced
1
Place the bar on your traps. You may need a pad so the bar doesn't dig into your cervical spine.
2
Push your hips straight back. Your knees should stay MOSTLY extended (think soft knees). Also make sure to
3
Look for what feels like a stretch in your hamstrings. The stretch feeling means you're likely nearing the end of your Range of Motion without rounding your spine.
4
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're in a standing position.

candidates.name: Ez Bar Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Ez Bar Romanian Deadlift
Novice
1
Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

candidates.name: Ez Bar Zercher Squat
candidates.cardText:
Ez Bar Zercher Squat
Beginner
1
Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
2
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
3
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

candidates.name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Hold trap bar, stand tall with slight knee bend.
2
Hinge hips back, lowering bar along thighs.
3
Keep back neutral and tension in hamstrings.
4
Drive hips forward to return upright.

candidates.name: Trap Bar Pause Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Trap Bar Pause Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Set up inside trap bar with strong brace and neutral spine.
2
Lift bar slightly, pause just below knees.
3
Hold tension, then continue to full lockout.
4
Lower bar slowly back to floor.

candidates.name: Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand on elevated surface inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
2
Grip handles, brace core, maintain neutral spine.
3
Drive through feet, extend hips and knees to stand.
4
Lower under control, maintaining balance on platform.

candidates.name: Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand inside trap bar. Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
2
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

candidates.name: Trap Bar Single Leg Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Trap Bar Single Leg Deadlift
Advanced
1
Stand inside trap bar, lift one foot slightly off ground.
2
Hinge hips back while lowering bar and extending free leg behind.
3
Keep hips square and back neutral throughout movement.
4
Drive through standing foot to return upright.

candidates.name: Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Loop bands under your feet or anchors and around the barbell. Stand tall with soft knees.
2
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bar close and back straight throughout.
3
Squeeze glutes, drive hips forward, and return to full standing position.

candidates.name: Barbell Banded Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Banded Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Loop bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand hip-width apart.
2
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat, and lower to grasp the bar.
3
Drive through heels, extend hips and knees, and stand tall with shoulders back.

candidates.name: Barbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
Intermediate
1
Stand on a platform holding barbell in front with feet hip-width apart.
2
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
3
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

candidates.name: Barbell Rack Pull
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Rack Pull
Beginner
1
Set barbell just below knee height in rack and stand hip-width apart.
2
Hinge at hips, grip bar firmly, and keep back flat.
3
Drive hips forward and stand tall, locking out at the top.

candidates.name: Barbell Hang Clean And Press
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Hang Clean And Press
Advanced
1
Hold bar just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
2
Explosively pull bar to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
3
Stand tall and press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.

candidates.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, palms facing each other, and hold it in front of your thighs.
2
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and push your hips back, allowing the landmine to travel down your thighs. Lower the landmine by bending forward at the hips while keeping your back flat, allowing the barbell to move closer to the floor. Continue the movement until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your legs relatively straight but with a slight bend in the knees.
3
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips forward and driving through your heels while keeping your back straight.
4
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

candidates.name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Grab the end of the landmine and stand perpendicular to the bar.
2
Lift your inside leg and keep your outside leg planted.
3
Push your hips back keeping your knees mostly extended. When you feel the stretch in your hams, push your hips forward until you are standing upright.

candidates.name: Landmine Snatch
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Snatch
Intermediate
1
Hold the end of the bar in front of you.
2
Pop your hips, pull your elbows up to the ceiling, and get underneath the bar.

candidates.name: Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
Advanced
1
Stand in a staggered position. With the back leg bent and the front mostly extended.
2
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch through your front hamstring.
3
Push your hips back forward until you are standing.

candidates.name: Landmine T Bar Rows
candidates.cardText:
Landmine T Bar Rows
Beginner
1
Grab a v bar and place it under the bar's collar.
2
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.
3
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

candidates.name: Barbell Suitcase Carry
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Suitcase Carry
Advanced
1
Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
2
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
3
Set the bar down and switch sides.

candidates.name: Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Set up for a sumo deadlift, grip the barbell.
2
Lift, pause at knee height.
3
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
Advanced
1
Stand centered over the barbell, feet shoulder-width apart.
2
Grip the bar with both hands, one in front, one behind.
3
Lift by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight, then lower slowly.

candidates.name: Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Set up for a standard deadlift, grip the barbell.
2
Lift, pause at knee height.
3
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, plates should be on blocks, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
2
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
3
Stand to your full height and hold.
4
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

candidates.name: Barbell Deficit Conventional Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Deficit Conventional Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, feet should be on a plate or elevated platform, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
2
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
3
Stand to your full height and hold.
4
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

candidates.name: Barbell Muscle Snatch
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Muscle Snatch
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip, and keep your back straight and core engaged.
2
Lift the barbell by explosively extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the bar close to your body.
3
As the bar reaches chest level, rotate your wrists and elbows up and back, transitioning into an overhead press.
4
Fully extend your arms overhead, stabilize the bar, then lower it back to the starting position with control.

candidates.name: Barbell High Pull
candidates.cardText:
Barbell High Pull
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
2
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
3
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.

candidates.name: Barbell Power Snatch
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Power Snatch
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide (outside shoulders), hook grip recommended.
2
Keep chest up, back straight, and drive through heels to lift the bar off the ground, keeping it close to your body.
3
As the bar reaches mid-thigh, explode upwards by extending hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging shoulders and pulling the bar high.
4
Drop under the bar slightly, catching it overhead with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.

candidates.name: Barbell Clean And Jerk
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the bar just outside your knees. Pull the bar from the floor by driving through your legs, keeping your back straight.
2
As the bar reaches your hips, extend explosively, shrug, and drop under to catch it in a front squat position with elbows high. Stand up tall.
3
Dip slightly, then drive through your legs to push the bar overhead.
4
Stabilize the bar overhead, lock arms, then bring feet together before lowering the bar safely.

candidates.name: Barbell Snatch
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Snatch
Advanced
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, chest up, and back straight.
2
Lift the bar by driving through your legs, keeping it close to your body. Extend your hips and knees while maintaining a straight back.
3
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar as it moves upward.
4
Drop into a deep squat while locking the bar overhead. Stabilize, then stand up fully to complete the lift.

candidates.name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
2
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
3
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
4
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.

candidates.name: Barbell Zercher Deficit Lunge
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Zercher Deficit Lunge
Advanced
1
Begin by standing with your feet on a plate and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
2
Step back with one foot off the plate and lower your back knee to the floor.
3
Push through your front leg and bring your back foot to the plate.

candidates.name: Barbell Clean And Press
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Clean And Press
Advanced
1
Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell just outside thighs.
2
Explosively extend hips and pull bar to shoulders in one motion.
3
Press overhead until arms lock out, then lower bar under control.
